overview: UKG Ready uses OAuth 2.0. You register an application through the UKG developer portal, receive a Client ID and Client Secret, and redirect users through UKG Ready's authorisation flow.

oauth_client_id.label: Client ID
oauth_client_id.description: Issued after registering your application at developer.ukg.com.

oauth_client_secret.label: Client Secret
oauth_client_secret.description: Issued with the Client ID. Keep it confidential.

steps.title: Apply for API access
steps.description: Go to developer.ukg.com and register an application. UKG Ready API access requires approval.

steps.title: Configure your application
steps.description: Once approved, configure your app with the Nolixan callback URL as the redirect URI.
steps.warning: Redirect URI must match exactly during the OAuth flow.

steps.title: Copy credentials
steps.description: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from your application settings.
steps.warning: Keep the Client Secret secure. Never expose it in client-side code.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: Create the integration in Nolixan with the Client ID and Client Secret, then initiate the OAuth flow.

tips: UKG Ready API access typically requires a formal approval process — allow lead time.
Tokens expire and Nolixan handles auto-refresh.
Contact UKG support if you need elevated API access for workforce management features.
